B: Hiya! Can you hear me? I'm Gemma, I'm in Beeston, near Nottingham.
A: Yeah. Kacper. Swindon.
B: Swindon, lovely. Is that the one with the Magic Roundabout?
A: Yeah, that one. It's fine once you know it.
B: I'd be terrified. What do you do?
A: Shift manager. Distribution centre, nights and weekends. About forty on my team.
B: Nights! Oh God, how do you do it? I do a ten-hour clinic day and I'm knackered. I'm a physio, NHS outpatients, musculoskeletal, and I do private sports massage on Saturdays.
A: You get used to it. Four on, four off. I'm on my days off now.
B: Oh, so I'm keeping you from your bed, sorry! I could tell from your photo you're a gym person, with the shaker.
A: Yeah, four times a week. PureGym, it's twenty-four hours, so I go whenever.
B: See, I do reformer Pilates, twice a week in West Bridgford. The instructor's terrifying but amazing. Have you ever tried it?
A: No. Seems expensive.
B: Haha, it is, don't tell me mum. But honestly, for lifters it's brilliant, all your mobility and your core, it sort of stops you getting injured. I see so many gym lads in clinic with dodgy lower backs, do you know what I mean?
A: My lower back's alright. Hips get tight sometimes, on squats.
B: Hips, yeah, that's classic. Do you warm up properly or just go straight in?
A: Erm. Bit of both.
B: That's a no, then! You want some hip stretches before you squat, honestly, just five minutes. Sorry, I'll stop, I'm in work mode. Do you live on your own down there?
A: With my sister and her husband. I rent their spare room. Saving for a deposit.
B: Oh, that's nice. We've got a lodger, actually, so the other way round, he helps with the mortgage. He leaves the hob on. Please tell me you don't leave the hob on.
A: No. I meal-prep, I'm pretty careful. Dan would kill me.
B: Dan? My husband's called Dan!
A: Right. It's a common name.
B: Haha, fair enough. Everyone today's got something the same. Two people with dogs called Biscuit and everything. Are your family in Swindon as well, then?
A: Yeah, my parents too. We came from Poland when I was ten. Gdańsk.
B: Oh, I've heard Gdańsk is gorgeous. Is it worth a trip? I've been wanting somewhere a bit different. We did Santorini for our honeymoon, which was stunning, but I want somewhere less obvious next.
A: It's nice. The old town. I go back once a year to see my grandparents. I want to do Dubai next, though.
B: Ooh, Dubai. That's very fancy.
A: A mate from work went. Looked good. Bit of a flashy one, yeah.
B: I love a bit of flashy. Life's too short for budget airline queues. Did you ever do any sport besides the gym? Football or anything?
A: Five-a-side for a bit. Stopped because of the rota. Mostly FIFA now, on PlayStation.
B: Haha, that's basically five-a-side without the ankle injuries, isn't it. I had a fella earlier who does five-a-side on Wednesdays and...
